title: Kamenný Strážce – nový
prompt: Front view of a living stone guardian, a walking wall: a huge golem built from fitted castle wall blocks and granite, battlements and crenellations on its shoulders, an iron portcullis set in its chest, glowing amber dwarven runes carved into its blocks, two glowing amber eyes in a blocky stone head, standing in a narrow snowy mountain pass. Cold blue dusk with warm amber rune glow. Palette: granite grey, amber runes, cold blue. Game avatar portrait: the glowing eyes clearly readable even when small, single creature, no text, no border.

Overcast grey light with a warm golden glow from the runes. Palette: granite, gold glow, snow white.
